checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Fox matches mascot design across all three
must.why: Face, markings, tail and proportions consistent; the reading pose is a bit more stylised and tilted but still the same fox.
Orange hoodie visible in all three.

must.item: Bike in park, baking cookies in kitchen, reading under tree
must.why: All three scenes are clearly depicted.
Same outlined flat style; no legible text. The small marks in the grass in image 4 are not letters.

faults.what: The reading picture has a white background sky and the fox is in profile with a tilted head, so it looks slightly less like the reference. The tree canopy is cropped.
The bike image has the fox's hoodie partly merged with the tail, and the legs and bike overlap awkwardly. The fox's mouth is open with a tongue, unlike the reference.
The kitchen picture has a stray line at right, and its shading is slightly heavier.

summary: Three consistent, square, text-free flat-cartoon fox scenes (bike, cookies, reading) came out, with only minor pose and background quirks.
